CREATE TABLE "public"."company" (
  "address" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'AZN' NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "taxId" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "company_currency_check_645607a3" CHECK ("currency" IN ('USD', 'EUR', 'AZN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."customer" (
  "address" text,
  "companyId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "taxId" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."product" (
  "companyId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "purchasePrice" numeric NOT NULL,
  "salePrice" numeric NOT NULL,
  "sku" text NOT NULL,
  "unit" text DEFAULT 'pcs' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."purchaseInvoice" (
  "companyId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text NOT NULL,
  "discount" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "dueDate" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "invoiceNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "issueDate" timestamptz,
  "notes" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ISSUED' NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "supplierId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "tax" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "total" numeric NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "warehouseId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "purchaseInvoice_currency_check_645607a3" CHECK ("currency" IN ('USD', 'EUR', 'AZN')),
  CONSTRAINT "purchaseInvoice_status_check_41b49830" CHECK ("status" IN ('ISSUED', 'PAID', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."purchaseInvoiceItem" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "invoiceId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "lineTotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "productId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" numeric NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."salesInvoice" (
  "companyId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text NOT NULL,
  "customerId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "discount" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "dueDate" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "invoiceNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "issueDate" timestamptz,
  "notes" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ISSUED' NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "tax" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "total" numeric NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "warehouseId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "salesInvoice_currency_check_645607a3" CHECK ("currency" IN ('USD', 'EUR', 'AZN')),
  CONSTRAINT "salesInvoice_status_check_41b49830" CHECK ("status" IN ('ISSUED', 'PAID', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."salesInvoiceItem" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "invoiceId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "lineTotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "productId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" numeric NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."stockMovement" (
  "companyId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "productId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "purchaseInvoiceId" int4,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "salesInvoiceId" int4,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "warehouseId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "stockMovement_type_check_d544519b" CHECK ("type" IN ('PURCHASE', 'SALE', 'ADJUSTMENT_IN', 'ADJUSTMENT_OUT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."supplier" (
  "address" text,
  "companyId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "taxId" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."warehouse" (
  "address" text,
  "companyId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."warehouseStock" (
  "companyId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "productId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "warehouseId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
